name: Beijing Haixin Energy Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Beijing Haixin Energy Technology Co.,Ltd. provides catalytic purification materials in China and internationally. It offers hydrocarbon-based biodiesel and bio-jet fuel; functional chemicals, such as catalysts and purifying agents for use in coal chemical, petrochemical, and natural gas industries; and dry and wet desulfurization technology services, desulfurization equipment leasing, and desulfurizing agent.
